newsitem.title: USA: Cold airmass bears watching in Brazil - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cold airmass bears watching in Brazil - WSC.

text.p: A storm system is expected to intensify off the coast of Uruguay over the weekend bringing colder air to Brazil's coffee belt, Weather Services Corp said in an update Tuesday.

According to WSC, the airmass does not appear to be cold enough to cause damage to crops. But this can change and bears close watching. Right now, WSC does not expect temperatures to dip below 39-46 F (4-8 C).
The weather this morning was fair with partly cloudy skies and below-normal temperatures. Lows ranged 45-55 F (7-13 C).

Increasing clouds are expected for the remainder of today with the chance of scattered showers developing. Mostly cloudy skies and shattered showers will develop Wednesday and Thursday. There is a chance of scattered showers Friday. Temperatures will remain near to below normal, with lows in the 50s to low 60s F (low to middle teens C).
WSC expects fair skies to arrive later in the weekend.
